title: E. Howard Hunt's occult novels attacking the Kennedys

tellings.quote: And oh my god, it's an attack on the Kennedys, the Kennedys as Satan worshippers, thinly veiled kind of of a story about that.

plain: E. Howard Hunt wrote occult novels, sometime between the 1960s and 1970s, that are said to be a thinly veiled attack on the Kennedys, casting them as Satan worshippers. The writer Peter Levenda describes them to Michels from his own reading, without naming which books. He brings them up as a sign that hostility to the Kennedys was being worked out in coded fiction.
